name: fairverdict
description: Evidence-based comparisons with weighted scores, fact checks and robustness checks. Delivers a formatted Markdown report and a concise chat summary.

interface.longDescription: Compare tools, technologies, products and approaches on criteria fixed before research. Get a scored verdict, its trade-offs and robustness checks in a Markdown file, with a brief summary in chat.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compare PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB for a SaaS backend with heavy reporting. Give me a short Markdown report and a brief summary in chat.
